name: Weekly Shopping + Ingredient Macro Fit
changes: Shopping list now aggregates a full seven-day nutrition week
Weekly plan includes PUSH, PULL, LEGS, UPPER, LOWER and two RECOVERY days
Shopping quantities are totaled across the week and show number/day markers
Current-day recipe substitutions are reflected in the weekly shopping list
Shopping completion state is persisted by week instead of only day/session
Recipe replacement now performs ingredient-level quantity optimization
Macro-fit considers calories, protein, carbs and fat instead of calories alone
The engine evaluates each meal and selects the best fitted recipe/meal pairing
Adjusted ingredient quantities and recalculated macros are written to Journal
Macro-fit metadata is persisted for traceability
technical_note: Ingredient nutrition values are an embedded estimation table for the current recipe catalogue. The fit is deterministic and bounded to avoid unrealistic portion changes.
